findings.title: No runtime detection or alerting for tenant-isolation (RLS) regressions
findings.note: portal_rls_bypass_total / portal_rls_enforced_total metrics (apps/api/src/lib/metrics.ts:175-207) + rules infra/digitalocean/prometheus.rules.yml:126-186; unit tests infra/digitalocean/prometheus.rules.test.yml:26-73; promtool is wired into CI (.github/workflows/validate.yml:50, test.yml:52) and both commands pass locally (docker prom/prometheus:v3.5.1: 22 rules SUCCESS + rule tests SUCCESS). Alert delivery remains unexercised and is tracked under OBS-P2-014/NOTIF-P2-011, not this finding.

findings.title: Approved-membership RLS predicate reintroduced six times; pending/suspended members could access tenant data
findings.note: node scripts/check-rls-predicate.mjs -> PASS (no raw status-unfiltered membership predicate in 30 migrations newer than 5302430); guard wired at .github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:125. The one live pre-baseline exception is carried under DATA-P1-001.

findings.title: MSP platform-admin role keys missing from post-5302129 admin-gate RLS policies
findings.note: 5302436_restore_platform_admin_rls_gates.sql recreates all five regressed DELETE gates with public.user_has_role(...) and asserts the qual contains user_has_role; node scripts/verify-rls.mjs reports 0 failures.

findings.title: webhook_dead_letters has no user-scoped DELETE policy while the API deletes via the RLS client
findings.note: 5302452_webhook_dead_letters_delete_policy.sql adds the manage-scoped DELETE policy plus an in-migration assertion.

findings.title: approve_project_task / add_project_task_comment trust a caller-supplied user id and are granted to authenticated
findings.note: 5302435 binds p_user_id to auth.uid() for end-user calls and keeps approved-membership checks + search_path pinning.

findings.title: API defaults to the service-role DB client (RLS bypass)
findings.note: rls-startup-check.ts:31-58 refuses to boot in production with an empty RLS_READS_ENABLED and logs loudly for writes; getScopedClient (services/supabase.ts:197-224) still falls back to the service-role client for any module not in the allow-list, and the allow-list values live in GitHub environment secrets (docs/RLS-rollout.md:93-94; deploy-do.yml:708), so the deployed posture is not reproducible from the repo.

findings.title: document_versions UPDATE policy still uses the raw unfiltered membership predicate
findings.note: 5302447 recreates dv_update with the approved-aware is_org_member + documents:edit predicate.

findings.title: store_quotes public INSERT policy allows arbitrary organization_id after tenant scoping
findings.note: 5302448 replaces the blanket store_quotes INSERT with anon null-org and authenticated null-org-or-approved-member policies.

findings.title: Auth write endpoints call GoTrue admin APIs through the RLS-scoped client
findings.note: auth.admin.* calls go through getSupabaseAdmin (routes/auth.ts:319,399,716,725); the user-scoped client is used only for non-admin operations.

findings.title: 5302116 grants anon UPDATE/DELETE on every table, amplified by no RLS-off × anon-write lint
findings.note: 5302434 removes the blanket/default anon DML grant and keeps only the declared allowlist; however there is still no lint that fails a new 'grant ... to anon' (grep scripts/ and .github/ for anon grants -> only scripts/ci/rls-matrix.sql). verify-rls rule 1 covers the RLS-off half by failing any live table without RLS.

findings.title: No behavioral RLS allow/deny matrix test (static gate only)
findings.note: scripts/ci/rls-matrix.sql (allow/deny assertions over tickets/time_entries/audit_logs/satisfaction_pulses/module_timeline_events with approved/pending/cross-tenant/anon actors) runs via scripts/ci/check-rls-matrix.sh, wired at .github/workflows/e2e.yml:101 after db reset.

findings.title: storage_path_org_id trusts a client-controlled object name
findings.note: storage_path_org_id is unchanged and still name-derived (5302026:799-829); 5302439 removed the authenticated INSERT/UPDATE policies so direct writes no longer exist, and the API enforces path-org equality (documents.ts:284-287,549-556), but the SELECT/DELETE storage policies still derive the org from the client-controlled object name.

findings.title: Duplicate scoped-client tests and stale coverage-matrix snapshot
findings.note: both duplicate suites still exist (apps/api/src/__tests__/supabase-scoped-client.test.ts and get-scoped-client.test.ts); docs/RLS-coverage-matrix.md:5-7 is now explicitly labelled a snapshot with verify-rls.mjs as the live source, but its counts are still not guarded by check-docs-counts.mjs.

findings.title: RLS policies reference `manage` permissions that no role holds (dead predicates)
findings.note: 5302459 inserts the missing permission-catalog rows; node scripts/check-permission-catalog.mjs -> PASS (198 requirePermission + 46 live-policy references resolve against 338 catalog keys).

findings.title: No static lint for RLS role-gate drift or policy↔permission-catalog drift
findings.note: verify-rls.mjs enforces role-gate drift (baseline 5302436) and policy<->catalog drift; wired at .github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:101,109; ran -> 0 failures (1 baseline warning, see RLS-P3-008).

findings.title: Scoped-client adoption is partial: several tenant modules have no RLS call sites and service helpers bypass the scoped client
findings.note: getScopedClient is used at 417 call sites across apps/api/src/routes (grep); final CRUD/satisfaction/forms/approvals modules now have scoped call sites.

findings.title: Four live policies still hardcode partial platform-role lists (document_shares trio omits super_admin; notifications insert omits six platform keys)
findings.note: node scripts/verify-rls.mjs reports '[role-gate:baseline] 4 live policies created before 5302436 hardcode a partial platform-role list': notifications_insert_system_or_admin (5302057:41, omits 6 platform keys) and document_shares delete/insert/update own_org (5302129:1136,1150,1164, omit super_admin). Pre-baseline debt tolerated by the guard; the previous RLS-P2-001 note claimed no other short admin gates existed. New finding (P3).
